design: 宜捷行司机端专业出车工作台设计：重构为纯白底与深墨色高对比排版，以品质翡翠青绿为品牌强调色。将头部压缩为单行高集成信息条，将听单控制精简为56dp触控栏，将地图、定位状态、语音及次要工具折叠进可展开的'出车工具与状态'抽屉。在390x844dp屏幕上直接将第一张附近可接订单提升至首屏呈现，保持正文18sp、地址20/22sp、金额30sp及抢单主按钮60dp，消除政务表单式浅绿大卡片堆叠，全面契合年长司机快速辨识与稳健盲操需求。

functions.NativeTheme:
@Composable
fun NativeTheme(large: Boolean = false, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val size = 18.sp
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalDensity provides Density(density.density, density.fontScale * if (large) 1.12f else 1f)
    ) {
        MaterialTheme(
            colorScheme =
                lightColorScheme(
                    primary = Green,
                    onPrimary = Color.White,
                    background = Page,
                    surface = Color.White,
                    onSurface = Ink,
                    secondary = Green,
                    secondaryContainer = Pale,
                    onSecondaryContainer = Ink,
                    outline = Line,
                    surfaceVariant = Pale,
                    onSurfaceVariant = Muted,
                ),
            typography =
                Typography(
                    bodySmall = androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(fontSize = 14.sp, lineHeight = 20.sp),
                    labelMedium = androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(fontSize = 16.sp, lineHeight = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium),
                    labelSmall = androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(fontSize = 14.sp, lineHeight = 20.sp),
                    bodyLarge =
                        androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                            fontSize = size,
                            lineHeight = 26.sp,
                        ),
                    bodyMedium =
                        androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                            fontSize = size,
                            lineHeight = 26.sp,
                        ),
                    labelLarge =
                        androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                            fontSize = size,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        ),
                    titleLarge =
                        androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                            fontSize = 24.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        ),
                    titleMedium =
                        androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                            fontSize = 20.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        ),
                ),
            content = content,
        )
    }
}
functions.Pill:
@Composable
fun Pill(text: String, color: Color = Green, bg: Color = Pale) {
    Text(
        text = text,
        color = color,
        fontSize = 14.sp,
        lineHeight = 18.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
        modifier = Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .background(bg)
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
    )
}
